// legacyhost is built inside an untouched checkout of the 040 source tree
// (commit 1b445cf) and is never part of the intercore module. It is a library
// host as 040 allowed one to be: it opens and migrates the database with 040
// code, persists jobs through the real scheduler Store hooks, and runs the real
// DispatchExecutor with a fake dispatch.sh. Like 040, it persists a job as
// running when it starts and the dispatch link only when the executor returns.
//
//	legacyhost run <db> <dispatch.sh> <workdir>   start one job, print "started", block
//	legacyhost recover <db>                       print the ids 040 RecoverPending would re-run
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"github.com/mistakeknot/intercore/internal/db"
	"github.com/mistakeknot/intercore/internal/dispatch"
	"github.com/mistakeknot/intercore/internal/scheduler"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) < 3 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: legacyhost run|recover <db> ...")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	d, err := db.Open(os.Args[2], 5*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if err := d.Migrate(ctx); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	store := scheduler.NewStore(d.SqlDB())
	switch os.Args[1] {
	case "recover":
		jobs, err := store.RecoverPending(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			fatal(err)
		}
		for _, j := range jobs {
			fmt.Println(j.ID, j.Status)
		}
	case "run":
		run(ctx, d, store, os.Args[3], os.Args[4])
	default:
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("unknown command %q", os.Args[1]))
	}
}

func run(ctx context.Context, d *db.DB, store *scheduler.Store, dispatchSH, work string) {
	prompt := filepath.Join(work, "legacy.prompt")
	out := filepath.Join(work, "legacy.out")
	if err := os.WriteFile(prompt, []byte("sleep 120\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	opts, _ := json.Marshal(dispatch.SpawnOptions{
		AgentType: "codex", ProjectDir: work, PromptFile: prompt, OutputFile: out, DispatchSH: dispatchSH,
	})
	s := scheduler.New(scheduler.DefaultConfig())
	s.SetExecutor(scheduler.DispatchExecutor(dispatch.New(d.SqlDB(), nil)))
	s.SetHooks(scheduler.Hooks{
		OnJobEnqueued: func(j *scheduler.SpawnJob) {
			if err := store.Create(ctx, j); err != nil {
				fatal(err)
			}
		},
		OnJobStarted: func(j *scheduler.SpawnJob) {
			j.StartedAt = time.Now()
			if err := store.Update(ctx, j); err != nil {
				fatal(err)
			}
		},
	})
	if err := s.Start(); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	job := scheduler.NewSpawnJob("legacy-job", scheduler.JobTypeDispatch, "legacy-session")
	job.AgentType, job.ProjectDir, job.SpawnOpts = "codex", work, string(opts)
	if err := s.Submit(job); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 600; i++ {
		if _, err := os.Stat(out + ".started"); err == nil {
			fmt.Println("started")
			select {}
		}
		time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	fatal(fmt.Errorf("the legacy worker never started"))
}

func fatal(err error) {
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "legacyhost:", err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
